description: This file contains the definition of the Memcached cache class within the OpenCart system, implementing caching operations such as get, set, and delete using Memcached server.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: A class implementing cache operations using Memcached server in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from cache by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with a specific key and expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.
